10A.
Public Hearing to consider two timely-filed appeals of the Planning Commission's approval of the Westmont of Encinitas Assisted Living facility. The project site is located within the Residential 3 (R-3) Zone and the Coastal Zone in the community of New Encinitas. CASE NUMBER: 16-131 MUP/DR/PMW/EIA/CDP; APPLICANT: Richard Lux/Westmont Development, LLC; APPELLANT NO. 1: Linda Lux; APPELLANT NO. 2: Marilyn Dulich, Robert Denyer, Shaun Cornell, Kelli Cornell, Richard Markell, Kristen Markell, Dan Lowe, Dana Lowe, Linda Lux and Bobby Lux as members of the Encinitas Citizens for Responsible, Respectful Encinitas Development; LOCATION: 252 North El Camino Real (APN: 262-160-26 and -27). Contact Person: Associate Planner Mierau
NOTE: THIS ITEM HAS BEEN CONTINUED TO THE FEBRUARY 14, 2018 CITY COUNCIL MEETING. Written requests were received from the applicant and both appellants to continue the hearing to 2/14/18. The continuance will provide an opportunity for all parties involved to continue their discussions on key concerns raised by the appellants and hopefully come to a resolution that could result in both appellants withdrawing their appeals.
Option A: Deny both appeals, uphold the approval of the Planning Commission decision and adopt the draft City Council Resolution 2018-14.

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
